title: Paula Harris gets an Audrey call about Crestone

tellings.quote: herself boy that's beautiful I'd like to go and the phone rang and Audrey is on the phone she says don't worry you'll go back

plain: A woman named Paola Harris is said to have been thinking how beautiful Crestone, Colorado was and that she would like to go there, when the phone rang and a woman named Audrey told her, 'don't worry, you'll go back'. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something Harris related, in a conversation that also involves the UFO campaigner Steven Greer. The point is that the caller seemed to answer a thought Harris had never spoken aloud.
